title: Node polynomial resource witness
statement: For natural numbers $k$, $a$, and $b$, a node polynomial resource witness consists of a natural-number constant $C$ such that, for every pair of natural numbers $n$ and $c$, both the node random-example bound at degree parameter $k$ and per-call failure parameter given by the tree failure transformation applied to the dyadic failure at $c$, and the node uniform-work bound with those same parameters, are at most $C(n+1)^a(c+1)^b$.
hypotheses_covered: The random-example bound holds for every $n$ and $c$
The uniform-work bound holds for every $n$ and $c$
Both bounds use the specified tree-transformed dyadic per-call failure parameter
